title: Malicious code in @ts-expect-error/n (npm)
description: The npm package '@ts-expect-error/n' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, uncompromised device. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software or backdoors introduced by the package.
